title: Build or change a web game

stages.title: Reproduce the reported bug
acceptance: A test under tests/regression/ reproduces the reported bug and fails on the current code; report the test command, its nonzero exit code and quote the failing output.

stages.title: Specify the game and shared types
acceptance: docs/spec.md exists, is under 120 lines and defines core rules, win/draw/lose conditions, player counts, screens, controls and bot behaviour with a numbered list of every test case.
src/types.ts exports the JSON-compatible State and Action types used by rules and client; game.json metadata, player limits and bot support match docs/spec.md.

stages.title: Implement deterministic rules and bots
acceptance: src/rules.ts implements every rule in docs/spec.md through the pure deterministic RulesModule contract, with JSON state and seeded RNG state only.
npm test exits 0 with tests for each win and draw condition and at least five distinct illegal actions.
When game.json has bot: true, the bot returns a legal action for 200 deterministic seeds; report the seed range and passing test name.

stages.title: Create the SVG assets and responsive theme
acceptance: assets/thumb.svg exists and game.json references its built path thumb.svg.
src/client/theme.css covers every screen of docs/spec.md at 360 px and 1280 px width, with accessible contrast and touch targets of at least 44 px.
All art is original SVG and CSS, and no external font, image or other external resource is referenced.

stages.title: Integrate the SDK client and address QA rework
acceptance: The page renders SDK room state, turn, seats, result, disconnected opponents and errors, and sends moves and rematch through connectGame without computing rules itself.
npm run check, npm test and npm run build each exit 0; report all three exit codes.
npm run play serves the preview page, its ready URL returns HTTP 200 and the page loads; stop the preview cleanly after checking.
dist/ contains game.json, its HTML entry, self-contained ESM rules.js and every referenced asset, and HTML loads main.js and theme.css relatively.

stages.title: Verify gameplay, bundle and multiplayer in the browser
acceptance: a clean `npm install` followed by `npm run check`, `npm test` and `npm run build` all exit 0, report the three exit codes
a bot-versus-bot simulation over 50 seeds ends every match without an illegal move, and one human-versus-human match is played to a win and one to a draw or loss
illegal actions are rejected: wrong turn, invalid or occupied target, a move after the match ended
in the browser at 1280x800 and 390x844 the preview opens with no console errors and a full match can be played
multiplayer: two browser contexts stay in sync turn by turn and reloading one returns it to the same room and seat, or "n/a" with the reason for a game without multiplayer
